accepted.sentence: Growers often remove surplus basal shoots, retaining selected offshoots to limit crowding and reduce competition within a planting.
Fertilizer is often applied in small, repeated doses because shallow roots draw nutrients from a relatively limited soil volume.
Individual blossoms open successively along the flower cluster, extending the period during which flowering and fruit development occur.
Fruit peel, sugar, water, and spices can ferment together to make tepache, a traditional, lightly alcoholic drink.
Yeast fermentation of the sweet juice can produce a fruit wine, which is then strained and allowed to mature.
Pureed flesh spread thinly and dehydrated becomes flexible fruit leather that can be stored as a snack.
Processors can crush leftover stems and recover bromelain from the liquid for use in food production and other industries.
Growers may remove the first flower cluster from young plants to postpone fruiting until the plants are more established.
